# Dharmik Sheth

> Technical SEO & AI Automation Specialist based in Ahmedabad, India. In-house technical SEO, link building and content for two sister engineering-outsourcing firms (mechanical design and BIM/CAD), backed by custom Python tools, n8n workflows and AI-produced short-form video ads.

Dharmik Sheth has 18+ months of hands-on SEO experience. He owns technical SEO, content and link acquisition end to end: audits, keyword and competitor research, guest-post outreach, and reporting in Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console. His suite of 10 Python SEO tools took on-page analysis from 1–2 days down to one day per site, roughly halving audit turnaround.

## Services

- Technical SEO: audits, crawlability, indexation, metadata and site structure, tracked in GA4 and Search Console
- Link building & outreach: prospecting industry sites, editor outreach and negotiation, guest posts
- Content that ranks: case studies, guides, checklists, blogs and landing pages on mechanical design, FEA/CFD, sheet metal and reverse engineering
- Automation & AI video: Python SEO tools, n8n workflows, and short-form marketing videos made with Gemini, Google Flow and Google Vids

## Projects

- [Sheet Metal Design & Bend Calculator](https://sheet-metal-design-alpha.vercel.app/): Live sheet metal design website with an interactive [Bend Calculator](https://sheet-metal-design-alpha.vercel.app/tools/bend-calculator) for engineers and fabricators
- SEO Automation Toolkit: Ten Python tools (meta tag scraper and optimizer, image URL extractor, alt tag checker, internal link analyzer, AI generators for titles, meta descriptions, blogs and articles); used daily, cutting audit turnaround roughly in half
- n8n Content Workflow: Automated pipeline connecting AI content generation, review and WordPress publishing with no manual handoffs
- AI Website Chatbot: AI chatbot for an engineering services company website, answering visitor questions from a custom knowledge base with Google Gemini and capturing leads by email
- Content Asset Library: Case studies, guides, checklists and downloadable resources supporting organic acquisition and guest-post placement
- AI video ads: Short-form video ads for a US client promoting products and services on social media and in paid ads (ongoing campaign for a Google review stand product); all presenters and scenes are AI-generated
